A [[Color/Legends|silver]] '''protocol droid''' belonged to<ref name="The Unifying Force" /> the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]]<ref name="The Final Prophecy">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref> by [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The [[Protocol droid/Legends|droid]] and its owner were among a group of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] members held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]&mdash;an [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[True Way|religious]] zealots waging war on the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]]&mdash;at a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] compound on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Selvaris]], with Cracken having been captured<ref name="The Unifying Force" /> during a [[Second Battle of Bilbringi|battle]] at the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]]<ref name="The Final Prophecy" /> late in the [[28 ABY/Legends|previous year]].<ref name="NEC" />

The protocol [[Droid/Legends|droid]] calculated the odds of escaping the compound at roughly a million to one. Shortly thereafter, it was one of several dozen droids publicly immolated and destroyed by the prison's Yuuzhan Vong [[Priest caste|priests]] in a [[Fire/Legends|fire]] pit located outside of the compound's gates. Despite its calculations, several inmates were later able to escape with the aid of the intelligence-gathering [[Ryn Network]], an organization whose presence on Selvaris the protocol droid had been unaware.<ref name="The Unifying Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pash Cracken's protocol droid was mentioned in the [[2003]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]'', written by [[James Luceno]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' novel series.<ref name="The Unifying Force" />
